EWAR in the fight: mockup (all three deliveries)

The real page (main bd04bb5, v2026.11.13.2) with two made-up fits: the threat is an Arbitrator with 2 tracking disruptors (optimal and tracking scripts), a sensor dampener (range script), a multispectral ECM, 2 medium neuts and a small nosferatu; your ship is a blaster Thorax with an armor repairer. Fight range set to 4 km. Pick a phase to see what each delivery adds; A + B + C is the finished feature. The page's own code draws everything; a prototype changes what goes into it (see “How the numbers are made”).

What changes, phase by phase (at 4 km)

  • Today: your DPS on them 240, they last 1 min 17 s, you last 1 min 12 s. Their tracking disruptors, dampener, ECM and neuts are on the EWAR card only.
  • A, disruptors: your blasters' optimal, falloff and tracking shrink by their TDs at that range, so your DPS on them is 65 and they last 4 min 52 s. Their card's chart gets a D zone for the TDs' reach; your card gets a line under the chart; the “they last” panel says what was cut.
  • B, neuts and nos: their neuts and nosferatu go into your capacitor simulation, so your repairer stops sooner: you last 58 s. The C zone now counts; their card's line and the “you last” panel give the drain and when your capacitor empties.
  • C, targeting: their dampener cuts your lock range (the pin on your card moves and says “damped”); past it you deal nothing, and the same rule holds for every ship (you decided: lock range always counts). Lock times and their ECM's jam chance go into the “why” panels and their card's line. D zones for the damp and ECM reach. You last 58 s, they last 4 min 52 s.

Chart badges: the module's icon (A + B + C, their card)

Each badge shows the module's own icon (CCP's image server, as the fit ring and module rows already use), with the category colour kept small: a faint thin frame, or a short bar under the icon. The letter stays underneath in the category colour, so if the image server doesn't answer you still see today's letter. The key rows under the chart get the same icon. Hover the module name in a badge's tooltip to check it.

Phone (390 px), A + B + C

How the numbers are made (mockup)

  • Tracking disruptors: pyfa's handler (Effect6424) as a multiplier on your turrets' optimal, falloff and tracking, scaled by the TD's range factor at each distance and stacking-penalised, then the page's own application maths. Resistances left out (neither hull has one); the build adds them.
  • Capacitor: the page's own pyfa capacitor simulation with your modules' drains plus each neut and nos cycle (pyfa's addDrain, range factor applied). The page's “you last” then uses that empty time.
  • Lock range: your lock range times the dampener's stacking-penalised multiplier; lock time is pyfa's calculateLockTime; jam chance is pyfa's jamChance on your sensor strength.
  • Wording, the D/C letters and the line's place are proposals: tell me what to change.

Mockup only. Made-up fits, no player data. Built by build_ewar.py with proto_ewar.js (Project docs claude/roadmap/ewar-mockup/).
